newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P upgrades St George to A/A1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P upgrades St George to A/A1.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Wednesday it had raised its long-term and short-term counterparty ratings on St George Bank Ltd to A/A1 from A-minus/A2 and removed the ratings from CreditWatch.
"The rating upgrade follows the finalisation today of St George's acquisition of Advance Bank Ltd," Standard and Poor's said. "The rating outlook for St George is stable."

It said significant challenges in the next three years would be to fully integrate operations, minimise customer erosion, continue to grow traditional and new businesses, and draw out all the cost benefits from the rationalisation.
"Profitability of the merged bank will be better that that of St George on a stand alone basis in the medium term," it said.
St George acquired Advance through a mixture of cash and scrip which valued Advance at about A$2.65 billion.
At 12.10 p.m. (0110 GMT), St George shares were three cents up at A$7.90.
